title: Manager- Product Owner, Survey CoE, PEG Alpha
description:
About us
  
  

Bain \& Company is a global management consulting firm that helps the world’s most ambitious change makers define the future. Across 65 offices in 40 countries, we work alongside our clients as one team with a shared ambition to achieve extraordinary results, outperform the competition and redefine industries. Since our founding in 1973, we have measured our success by the success of our clients, and we proudly maintain the highest level of client advocacy in the industry.
  
  

In 2004, the firm established its presence in the Indian market by opening the Bain Capability Center (BCC) in New Delhi. The BCC is now known as BCN (Bain Capability Network) with its nodes across various geographies. BCN is an integral and largest unit of (ECD) Expert Client Delivery. ECD plays a critical role as it adds value to Bain's case teams globally by supporting them with analytics and research solutioning across all industries, specific domains for corporate cases, client development, private equity diligence or Bain intellectual property. The BCN comprises of Consulting Services, Knowledge Services and Shared Services.
  
  

Who you will work with
  
  

BCN Private Equity Group CoE at Bain \& Company provides specialized support to global teams across the private equity value chain, enabling clients to make key investment decisions. Our expertise lies in addressing critical diligence questions through a range of products such as survey analytics, digital diagnostic, workforce analytics and disruption assessment. Our teams work in a fast\-paced environment delivering consistent and impactful results at scale. In the last decade, we have witnessed an exponential growth, reaching \>250 members today from \~10 members in 2013\. We operate from 3 locations \- 2 in India and 1 in Poland, and operate across all 3 regions (EMEA, Americas and APAC). BCN PEG provides an opportunity to solve challenging business problems in a dynamic set\-up working closely with global Bain teams, acting as a thought\-partner with daily deliverables.
  
  

What you’ll do
  
  

Understand Users \& Identify What to Build
  
Own 2\-3 products/modules within the Survey Toolkit, develop deep understanding of Survey CoE workflows, gather and synthesise user feedback, and translate business problems into clear product requirements with defined success measures.
  
  

Own Requirements, Backlog \& Prioritisation
  
Maintain the product backlog, write epics, user stories and acceptance criteria, prioritise features based on user impact and business value, and ensure the engineering squad always has clarity on what to build and why.
  
  

Drive Product Delivery
  
Work closely with developers, QA, designers and Data/AI specialists across the full Agile delivery lifecycle — sprint planning, backlog refinement, reviews and retrospectives — while tracking progress and resolving blockers.
  
  

Drive Adoption \& Continuous Improvement
  
Support rollout of new features, create user documentation, monitor adoption metrics and qualitative feedback, and bring learnings back to the broader Survey Toolkit team to ensure consistency across the portfolio.
  
  

Shape AI\-Enabled Experiences
  
Identify opportunities for GenAI, agentic workflows and automation within the survey workflow, participate in testing AI\-powered features, and develop sufficient technical fluency to make informed product trade\-offs with engineering.
  
  

About you
  
* Bachelor's or Master's in Business, Engineering, Computer Science or a related field
* 5\+ years of relevant experience in product management, product ownership, technology delivery or digital products
* Must have experience taking digital products or features from requirements through development and release — working directly with software development teams
* Background in consulting, enterprise tech, SaaS or fast\-paced startup environments is beneficial
* Experience with analytics, research, survey products or professional services workflows is a plus but not required

title: Data Products Manager
description:
**About 1Lattice:**



1Lattice™ is a 360\-degree business decision support platform with a tech\-enabled services stack of data, people network, and custom research. Powered by advanced tech tools and unique data\-gathering approaches, 1Lattice offers an integrated product suite to make decisions smartly, right from Inputs to Validation, Execution and Measurement. 1Lattice works with clients and partners globally, helping them solve a wide variety of business and organizational problems through actionable research\-led insights.

  


**About the role**



We are looking for a Data Products Manager who can research markets and businesses, organise data and turn it into useful insights. The role involves working with information from websites, reports, databases, APIs and other external sources.



The person should be comfortable understanding a business problem, finding the right data, structuring it properly and presenting clear findings. This is primarily a research and analytics role, not a machine learning role.

  


**Key responsibilities**


* Research industries, markets, companies, competitors and customers.
* Understand business questions and decide what information and data are required.
* Find relevant data from public sources, government portals, company websites, reports, databases and APIs.
* Collect and combine information from spreadsheets, PDFs, websites and other sources.
* Create and maintain data models for business entities, attributes and relationships.
* Clean, standardise, validate and remove duplicate data.
* Use SQL, Excel and Python to analyse data and identify trends, gaps and opportunities.
* Prepare market sizing, benchmarking, company profiling and comparative analysis.
* Build simple scoring and classification models where required.
* Document data sources, definitions, assumptions and limitations.
* Present findings through reports, presentations and dashboards.
* Work with product and engineering teams when research or data needs to be included in a product.

  


**Required skills**


* Strong business and secondary research skills.
* Good understanding of business models, industries and market structures.
* Strong Excel and SQL skills.
* Working knowledge of Python, especially Pandas.
* Good understanding of relational data modelling.
* Experience cleaning and combining data from multiple sources.
* Ability to define metrics, categories and scoring methods.
* Basic knowledge of APIs and web scraping using tools such as BeautifulSoup, Scrapy or Playwright.
* Ability to explain findings clearly to business and product teams.

  


**Education and experience**


* B.Tech in a relevant discipline or an MBA from a recognised institution.
* 3–6 years of experience in business research, data analytics, market intelligence, consulting or a related role.
* Experience working with incomplete or unstructured business data.

  


**Preferred experience**


* Experience in a consulting, research, analytics or data\-driven product company.
* Experience with external business, consumer, healthcare, financial, demographic or geographic datasets.
* Knowledge of Power BI, Tableau, Metabase or a similar visualisation tool.
* Exposure to statistical analysis, geospatial data or LLM\-based information extraction.

  


**What we are looking for**



The ideal candidate is curious, detail\-oriented and comfortable working with incomplete information. They should be able to investigate a topic independently, question the quality of a source and organise the findings in a way that others can use.

title: Sr. EDT Product Manager, Global Labeling Solutions
description:
### **Why join Stryker?**


Looking for a place that values your unique talents? Discover Stryker's award\-winning culture.  

We are proud to offer you our total rewards package which includes bonuses, healthcare, insurance benefits, retirement programs, wellness programs, as well as service and performance awards – not to mention various social and recreational activities, all of which are location specific.### **Job description**


We are excited to be named one of the World’s Best Workplaces by Fortune Magazine!
  

We are proud to offer you our total rewards package which includes bonuses, healthcare, insurance benefits, retirement programs, wellness programs, as well as service and performance awards – not to mention various social and recreational activities, all of which are location specific. **Senior Manager, EDT Product Manager, Global Labeling Solutions**


The Product Manager, Global Labeling Solutions owns the end\-to\-end lifecycle of the enterprise labeling capabilities that enable compliant, accurate, scalable, reliable, and efficient label design, approval, content management, and printing across global manufacturing and distribution operations. This role translates customer needs, business goals, and regulatory expectations into a clear product vision, roadmap, and measurable outcomes that advance design control, change management, global product data governance, and digital thread capabilities. The Product Manager will operate with a “mini\-CEO” mindset—customer\-obsessed, data\-driven, and accountable for decisions, trade\-offs, value realization, adoption, total cost of ownership, and delivery results.


**What You Will Do**

* Define and execute the global product vision, strategy, and roadmap for enterprise labeling capabilities, ensuring alignment with business objectives, manufacturing needs, regulatory requirements, and industry trends.
* Own the end\-to\-end product lifecycle, from ideation and prioritization through delivery, adoption, optimization, and continuous improvement.
* Partner with cross\-functional stakeholders across R\&D, Quality, Regulatory, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, and Digital Technology to translate business needs into scalable labeling solutions and measurable outcomes.
* Manage and prioritize the product backlog, balancing business value, technical feasibility, compliance requirements, and operational priorities while driving informed trade\-off decisions.
* Serve as the product owner and subject matter expert for Loftware Cloud and/or Loftware Cloud Clinical Trials, overseeing capabilities including label design, content and template management, workflow automation, print execution, auditability, and validation readiness.
* Lead the design and evolution of integrations between labeling platforms and enterprise systems (ERP, PLM, MES, WMS, clinical supply, and master data systems) to enable accurate, data\-driven label generation and printing.
* Establish and maintain governance frameworks for labeling processes, templates, translations, version control, access management, change control, release management, and lifecycle support in a regulated environment.
* Ensure labeling solutions meet global compliance and quality standards, including UDI, MDR, GxP, validation requirements, audit readiness, traceability, and electronic records/signatures regulations.
* Drive stakeholder engagement, change management, training, and adoption initiatives to enable successful deployment and long\-term business value realization across global teams.
* Monitor product performance, user feedback, and industry developments to identify opportunities for process improvement, standardization, operational efficiency, and enhanced user experience.

**What You Need**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related discipline (Master's degree preferred), with 10–12\+ years of experience in product management, platform ownership, or enterprise application delivery within regulated industries.
* Proven expertise with Loftware Cloud and/or Loftware Cloud Clinical Trials, including label design, template and content management, approval workflows, print management, auditability, and validation\-ready platform capabilities.
* Strong understanding of enterprise labeling ecosystems and integrations with business\-critical platforms such as ERP, PLM, MES, WMS, clinical supply, and master data systems.
* Demonstrated experience defining product strategy, managing roadmaps and backlogs, prioritizing investments, and delivering complex technology solutions that balance business value, user experience, technical feasibility, and compliance requirements.
* Deep knowledge of MedTech, life sciences, or other regulated environments, including GxP, UDI, MDR, validation, traceability, audit readiness, and electronic records/signatures requirements.
* Exceptional stakeholder management, communication, and influencing skills, with a proven ability to lead cross\-functional teams, drive change, and achieve alignment across global matrix organizations.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving capabilities, using data, customer insights, and product metrics to inform decisions, measure outcomes, and continuously improve platform adoption and effectiveness.
* Experience managing external vendors, implementation partners, and consultants, coupled with an ownership mindset, customer focus, and passion for driving innovation and operational excellence through enterprise labeling solutions.

Stryker is a global leader in medical technologies and, together with its customers, is driven to make healthcare better. The company offers innovative products and services in MedSurg, Neurotechnology, Orthopaedics and Spine that help improve patient and healthcare outcomes. Alongside its customers around the world, Stryker impacts more than 150 million patients annually.

title: Associate Corporate Relation Support Manager
description:
**Some careers open more doors than others.**

  

If you’re looking. for a career that will unlock new opportunities, join HSBC and experience the possibilities. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further

 **International Mid Markets**


HSBC provides international financial services solutions that support businesses ranging from large corporates to mid\-market enterprises in a variety of industry sectors all over the world. Leveraging the strength, scope and expertise of our global product network, International Mid markets (IMM) is positioned as an essential partner to large and mid\-market enterprises seeking to maximize their potential internationally, offering streamlined business access to HSBC’s international network and broad range of market leading banking products and services.


We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join the IMM Banking team in Gurgaon as Corporate Banking Manager

 **Principal Responsibilities**

  

* Delivery of revenue and asset/liability target(s) from existing portfolio of clients and the acquisition of new clients in a responsible manner and compliant with HSBC policies.
* Assist HSBC to attain its strategic growth targets in line with Portfolio Returns target of the bank and undertake cross sell initiatives to achieve the same. Focus would be to acquire and grow banking wallets in companies with international footprint .
* To regularly monitor and screen portfolio for early warning signals and take corrective actions as appropriate. To complete the Annual Reviews in a time bound manner and ensure housekeeping , approval conditions and covenant monitoring are tracked and closed in a timely manner.
* Mentoring of ARMs to deliver a broad base contribution to meet the client's needs and support ARM’s development.
* To liaise with various internal stakeholders (Risk, CDT OPS, GPS, GTS, etc) and ensure efficient servicing of corporate customers and capturing of wallet opportunities
* Ensure timely compliance with all FCC requirements for the portfolio. Ensure implementation of all audit and regulatory recommendations and constant monitoring/ review of the assigned portfolio.
* Demonstrate leadership in all aspects of your role, set exemplary standards, values and behaviours consistent with our Group values.
* Protect the reputation and integrity of the HSBC Brand. This should be evidenced by overall conduct ("do the right thing") and by proactively demonstrating active compliance with both the letter and the spirit of applicable laws, regulations, internal policies, procedures and Global Standards together with the management of risks including , but not limited to Credit, Operational, Regulatory (including Financial Crime), Reputational and Sustainability. Demonstrating through escalating and speaking up, a proactive approach to identifying when things go wrong or when potential risk issues are identified
* Proactively identify financial crime risks (AML, Sanctions and AB\&C) utilizing available tools / support functions as appropriate and undertaking all requisite actions to mitigate/eradicate unacceptable risk.

 **Qualifications**

  

* CA/MBA with relevant experience ( min 5 years ) in a client management and corporate banking role.
* Sound commercial banking skills including knowledge of credit and lending , trade and treasury products ,key market sectors, local regulatory environment, financial analysis etc.
* Excellent interpersonal skills and ability to interact and build relationships with internal and external stakeholders
* Ability to work on fast turnarounds, tight deadlines \& handle competing priorities
* **Pro\-tip :** Familiarity with AI\-enabled tools is an advantage
* Mandatory to successfully complete Anti\-Money Laundering and Sanctions training and post\-course assessment, as required.

  

As an employee, you are required to perform your duties in a professional capacity exercising independent judgement, discretion and decision\-making authority in planning, organising, directing work, supervising and appraising the work of team members, as applicable; and taking accountability for delivery outcomes. You will represent the organization with relevant internal and external stakeholders. You will allocate and prioritize work, provide direction and feedback, manage team capacity and leave in line with policy as applicable.

  

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment.

  

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

title: International Product Growth Manager, India
description:
Meta's mission is "Building the future of human connection and the technology that makes it possible."\~90% of people use our products from outside of North America, and we continue to expand internationally. We play a crucial role in breaking down the barriers for the international community to support our mission. If this excites you, we have a unique opportunity for you to join our dynamic team and help us achieve local at a global scale!As an International Product Growth Manager for India, you will ensure that Meta is locally relevant and successful in the region. With your deep understanding of the local product landscape and cultural context, you will identify product gaps, uncover growth opportunities, and drive the execution of growth initiatives for India.We're looking for a self\-driven individual with extensive knowledge of the market and products, and a passion for driving product growth to serve the needs of the international community. If you are ready to make a difference for your market through the Meta family of apps, we highly encourage you to apply!  

  

  

### **International Product Growth Manager, India Responsibilities:**

* Ensure the Meta family of apps is well adapted to be successful in India
* Provide local insights — identify strengths, weaknesses, opportunities and threats relevant for Meta's success in India
* Explore and identify strategic growth opportunities in India leveraging internal and external resources as well as in\-country activities
* Drive solutions that address the identified market\-specific opportunities
* Influence and partner with product teams to execute on the solutions
* Partner with the analytics team to identify high\-impact opportunities, validate key findings, and measure impact of execution

  

  

  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* 4\+ years of experience in product management, product growth, or business strategy
* Experience in the understanding of the India market, including its unique challenges and opportunities
* Native fluency in one or more indigenous languages used in India, such as Hindi, as this role requires the understanding of local product landscape and cultural context to develop solutions
* Excellent communication and collaboration experiences, with the ability to work effectively with and influence cross\-functional teams such as engineering, product management, and analytics across different countries and cultures, in English

  

  

  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Proficiency in data analysis and problem\-solving, with experience in interpreting data to inform decision\-making
* Experience working in a global environment across multiple time zones
* Experience working effectively in fast\-paced, ambiguous environments with minimal direction
* Experience working in startups or entrepreneurial ventures
* Experience with building products tailored to India

  

  

  

### **About Meta:**


Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.  

  

  

  

  

  

  

Individual compensation is determined by skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Compensation details listed in this posting reflect the base hourly rate, monthly rate, or annual salary only, and do not include bonus, equity or sales incentives, if applicable.
